restricted_count.rule: Texas governmental bodies in the record that took a recorded 2026 action aimed at a data center or at the incentive one depended on, of any binding force

declined_count.rule: bodies that had such an action in front of them and did not take it

stated_nonbinding.rule: acting bodies whose own source states the action does not bind

stated_binding.rule: acting bodies whose record shows the action changed a legal state on the day

force_unstated.rule: acting items carrying no `effective` key date at all, which is a measurement about the record and NOT a claim about what sources say. Round 13 and round 14 both hard failed a frame for printing the second over the first

late_cluster.rule: the later half of the acting bodies by ordered date, floor divided, so 7 of 15

late_span.rule: days from the 7th from last ordered action to the last, MEASURED after the half was chosen

still_dated.rule: of the 17 items this deck carries, those whose key_dates hold a step on or after 2026-08-25

chronology.rule: the actions in the order they happened

first_action_date.rule: earliest ORDERED date among the acting items, the date a body acted

last_action_date.rule: latest ORDERED date among the acting items

brazoria_applications.rule: distinct applicants whose Brazoria County hearing orders name Reinvestment Zone No. 26-01, the zone the court refused on March 10th, counted from the county's own Legistar matter titles

open_doors.rule: every item this deck weighed that carries a HEARING or a COMMENT WINDOW dated on or after the run date, in a public_access room a member of the public may enter. An effective date is not a door and a deadline on a body is not a door

candidates_count.rule: every 2026 dated item this deck weighed, whether it counted it, declined it or ruled it out. Selected on the record's own topic and title fields plus four ids admitted with a written reason, never on a regex over summary prose

doors_record_wide.rule: the same door test run over EVERY item in the record rather than over this deck's subject. Published because a frame that prints a door count has to say which set it counted, and round 13 hard failed one that did not

door_days_out.rule: days from the run date to the nearest open door

doors_local.rule: how many of the open doors sit with a local government, read off the record's own decider.type rather than off this deck's selection, so the closing frame's word local is the record's

approvals.rule: acting items whose cited claim records a body approving a data center project or the incentive one depends on, as opposed to regulating, refusing, studying or directing staff

resolutions.rule: acting items whose own cited claim calls the instrument a resolution

resolutions_binding.rule: acting items whose own cited claim calls the instrument a resolution AND whose effective date has arrived. Every one of the five resolutions is either stated non binding or is one the sources do not speak to, so this is zero, and it is the rule the deck can hand a reader

busiest_month.rule: the calendar month carrying the most acting dates

busiest_month_count.rule: how many of the acting dates fall in that month

busiest_body_binding.rule: how many of the binding actions the busiest body wrote

acting_bodies.rule: distinct places among the acting items

repeat_bodies.rule: acting places that appear on more than one action

busiest_body.rule: the acting place with the most actions

busiest_body_count.rule: how many actions the busiest place took

laredo_agendas.rule: hearing key_dates on tx-2026-0037, the agendas Laredo's direction reached

_doors.rule: each open door with its date, kind and room
